items.title: Laser spectroscopy helps reveal hidden nuclear properties in fermium
items.abstract: For the first time, researchers have determined the shape of the actinide nucleus of fermium-255 and measured its structure with high precision and resolution.

items.title: X(2370) emerges as glueball-dominated particle in collider experiments
items.abstract: At the International Conference on High Energy Physics in Brazil, the BESIII Collaboration report that, after 15 years of sustained research, it identified the dominant constituent of the X(2370) as a pseudoscalar glueball with spin-parity quantum numbers of 0⁻⁺.

items.title: Attosecond X-ray method maps early electron motions that trigger chemical reactions
items.abstract: All chemistry starts with a push from electrons. In the early moments of a chemical reaction, it's the movement of electrons that initiates the breaking of old chemical bonds and forging of new ones, transforming one molecule into another.
